note: Private campground near Tofield, 30 minutes east of Edmonton, with well-treed private sites, a heated pool, a playground and on-site security.  Each site has power, a picnic table and a fire pit; campers fill their water tanks at the pool house on the way in and use the sani-dump on the way out.  Generators are not permitted.  Stays run to a month at most, and seasonal spots go through a waitlist.  In 2026 the campground warned that stays after October 1 depend on the weather. --Claude
